audit_status.source_base: Greek Ephesians text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for alive from death, grace through trust, nations once far/near, one new humanity, peace, household/temple. Anti-Jewish and anti-body safeguards included.

verses.restored: And you, being dead in your trespasses and sins/misalignments,

familiar.text: And you hath he quickened, who were dead in trespasses and sins;

modern.text: And you were dead in your trespasses and sins,

original.text: Καὶ ὑμᾶς ὄντας νεκροὺς τοῖς παραπτώμασιν καὶ ταῖς ἁμαρτίαις ⸀ὑμῶν,

verses.restored: in which you once walked according to the age of this world, according to the ruler of the authority of the air, of the spirit now working in the children of disobedience,

familiar.text: Wherein in time past ye walked according to the course of this world, according to the prince of the power of the air, the spirit that now worketh in the children of disobedience:

modern.text: in which you used to walk when you conformed to the ways of this world and of the ruler of the power of the air, the spirit who is now at work in the sons of disobedience.

original.text: ἐν αἷς ποτε περιεπατήσατε κατὰ τὸν αἰῶνα τοῦ κόσμου τούτου, κατὰ τὸν ἄρχοντα τῆς ἐξουσίας τοῦ ἀέρος, τοῦ πνεύματος τοῦ νῦν ἐνεργοῦντος ἐν τοῖς υἱοῖς τῆς ἀπειθείας·

verses.restored: among whom we also all once conducted ourselves in the desires of our flesh, doing the wills of flesh and thoughts, and were by nature children of wrath, as also the rest.

familiar.text: Among whom also we all had our conversation in times past in the lusts of our flesh, fulfilling the desires of the flesh and of the mind; and were by nature the children of wrath, even as others.

modern.text: All of us also lived among them at one time, fulfilling the cravings of our flesh and indulging its desires and thoughts. Like the rest, we were by nature children of wrath.

original.text: ἐν οἷς καὶ ἡμεῖς πάντες ἀνεστράφημέν ποτε ἐν ταῖς ἐπιθυμίαις τῆς σαρκὸς ἡμῶν, ποιοῦντες τὰ θελήματα τῆς σαρκὸς καὶ τῶν διανοιῶν, καὶ ⸀ἤμεθα τέκνα φύσει ὀργῆς ὡς καὶ οἱ λοιποί·

verses.restored: But the Divine, being rich in mercy, because of his great love with which he loved us,

familiar.text: But God, who is rich in mercy, for his great love wherewith he loved us,

modern.text: But because of His great love for us, God, who is rich in mercy,

original.text: ὁ δὲ θεὸς πλούσιος ὢν ἐν ἐλέει, διὰ τὴν πολλὴν ἀγάπην αὐτοῦ ἣν ἠγάπησεν ἡμᾶς,

verses.restored: even when we were dead in trespasses, made us alive together with Messiah—by grace you have been saved/healed—

familiar.text: Even when we were dead in sins, hath quickened us together with Christ, (by grace ye are saved;)

modern.text: made us alive with Christ even when we were dead in our trespasses. It is by grace you have been saved!

original.text: καὶ ὄντας ἡμᾶς νεκροὺς τοῖς παραπτώμασιν συνεζωοποίησεν τῷ Χριστῷ— χάριτί ἐστε σεσῳσμένοι—

verses.restored: and raised us together and seated us together in the heavenlies in Messiah Jesus,

familiar.text: And hath raised us up together, and made us sit together in heavenly places in Christ Jesus:

modern.text: And God raised us up with Christ and seated us with Him in the heavenly realms in Christ Jesus,

original.text: καὶ συνήγειρεν καὶ συνεκάθισεν ἐν τοῖς ἐπουρανίοις ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ,

verses.restored: so that in the coming ages he might show the surpassing riches of his grace in kindness toward us in Messiah Jesus.

familiar.text: That in the ages to come he might shew the exceeding riches of his grace in his kindness toward us through Christ Jesus.

modern.text: in order that in the coming ages He might display the surpassing riches of His grace, demonstrated by His kindness to us in Christ Jesus.

original.text: ἵνα ἐνδείξηται ἐν τοῖς αἰῶσιν τοῖς ἐπερχομένοις ⸂τὸ ὑπερβάλλον πλοῦτος⸃ τῆς χάριτος αὐτοῦ ἐν χρηστότητι ἐφʼ ἡμᾶς ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ.

verses.restored: For by grace you have been saved/healed through trust; and this is not from yourselves, it is the gift of the Divine,

familiar.text: For by grace are ye saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God:

modern.text: For it is by grace you have been saved through faith, and this not from yourselves; it is the gift of God,

original.text: τῇ γὰρ χάριτί ἐστε σεσῳσμένοι ⸀διὰ πίστεως· καὶ τοῦτο οὐκ ἐξ ὑμῶν, θεοῦ τὸ δῶρον·

verses.restored: not from works, so that no one may boast.

familiar.text: Not of works, lest any man should boast.

modern.text: not by works, so that no one can boast.

original.text: οὐκ ἐξ ἔργων, ἵνα μή τις καυχήσηται.

verses.restored: For we are his workmanship, created in Messiah Jesus for good works, which the Divine prepared beforehand so that we might walk in them.

familiar.text: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus unto good works, which God hath before ordained that we should walk in them.

modern.text: For we are God’s workmanship, created in Christ Jesus to do good works, which God prepared in advance as our way of life. One in Christ (Philippians 2:1–4)

original.text: αὐτοῦ γάρ ἐσμεν ποίημα, κτισθέντες ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ ἐπὶ ἔργοις ἀγαθοῖς οἷς προητοίμασεν ὁ θεὸς ἵνα ἐν αὐτοῖς περιπατήσωμεν.

verses.restored: Therefore remember that formerly you, the nations in flesh, called uncircumcision by what is called circumcision in flesh made by hands,

familiar.text: Wherefore remember, that ye being in time past Gentiles in the flesh, who are called Uncircumcision by that which is called the Circumcision in the flesh made by hands;

modern.text: Therefore remember that formerly you who are Gentiles in the flesh and called uncircumcised by the so-called circumcision (that done in the body by human hands)—

original.text: Διὸ μνημονεύετε ὅτι ⸂ποτὲ ὑμεῖς⸃ τὰ ἔθνη ἐν σαρκί, οἱ λεγόμενοι ἀκροβυστία ὑπὸ τῆς λεγομένης περιτομῆς ἐν σαρκὶ χειροποιήτου,

verses.restored: that you were at that season without Messiah, alienated from the citizenship of Israel and strangers of the covenants of promise, having no hope and without Divine in the world.

familiar.text: That at that time ye were without Christ, being aliens from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers from the covenants of promise, having no hope, and without God in the world:

modern.text: remember that at that time you were separate from Christ, alienated from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers to the covenants of the promise, without hope and without God in the world.

original.text: ὅτι ⸀ἦτε τῷ καιρῷ ἐκείνῳ χωρὶς Χριστοῦ, ἀπηλλοτριωμένοι τῆς πολιτείας τοῦ Ἰσραὴλ καὶ ξένοι τῶν διαθηκῶν τῆς ἐπαγγελίας, ἐλπίδα μὴ ἔχοντες καὶ ἄθεοι ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ.

verses.restored: But now in Messiah Jesus, you who once were far away became near in the blood of Messiah.

familiar.text: But now in Christ Jesus ye who sometimes were far off are made nigh by the blood of Christ.

modern.text: But now in Christ Jesus you who once were far away have been brought near through the blood of Christ.

original.text: νυνὶ δὲ ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ ὑμεῖς οἵ ποτε ὄντες μακρὰν ⸂ἐγενήθητε ἐγγὺς⸃ ἐν τῷ αἵματι τοῦ Χριστοῦ.

verses.restored: For he is our peace, the One making both one and tearing down the dividing wall of the fence, the enmity in his flesh,

familiar.text: For he is our peace, who hath made both one, and hath broken down the middle wall of partition between us;

modern.text: For He Himself is our peace, who has made the two one and has torn down the dividing wall of hostility

original.text: αὐτὸς γάρ ἐστιν ἡ εἰρήνη ἡμῶν, ὁ ποιήσας τὰ ἀμφότερα ἓν καὶ τὸ μεσότοιχον τοῦ φραγμοῦ λύσας, τὴν ἔχθραν ἐν τῇ σαρκὶ αὐτοῦ,

verses.restored: making inactive the Law of commandments in decrees, so that he might create the two in himself into one new human, making peace,

familiar.text: Having abolished in his flesh the enmity, even the law of commandments contained in ordinances; for to make in himself of twain one new man, so making peace;

modern.text: by abolishing in His flesh the law of commandments and decrees. He did this to create in Himself one new man out of the two, thus making peace

original.text: τὸν νόμον τῶν ἐντολῶν ἐν δόγμασιν καταργήσας, ἵνα τοὺς δύο κτίσῃ ἐν ⸀αὑτῷ εἰς ἕνα καινὸν ἄνθρωπον ποιῶν εἰρήνην,

verses.restored: and might reconcile both in one body to the Divine through the cross, killing the enmity in it.

familiar.text: And that he might reconcile both unto God in one body by the cross, having slain the enmity thereby:

modern.text: and reconciling both of them to God in one body through the cross, by which He extinguished their hostility.

original.text: καὶ ἀποκαταλλάξῃ τοὺς ἀμφοτέρους ἐν ἑνὶ σώματι τῷ θεῷ διὰ τοῦ σταυροῦ ἀποκτείνας τὴν ἔχθραν ἐν αὐτῷ·

verses.restored: And coming, he announced good news of peace to you far away and peace to those near,

familiar.text: And came and preached peace to you which were afar off, and to them that were nigh.

modern.text: He came and preached peace to you who were far away and peace to those who were near.

original.text: καὶ ἐλθὼν εὐηγγελίσατο εἰρήνην ὑμῖν τοῖς μακρὰν καὶ ⸀εἰρήνην τοῖς ἐγγύς·

verses.restored: because through him we both have access in one Spirit to the Father.

familiar.text: For through him we both have access by one Spirit unto the Father.

modern.text: For through Him we both have access to the Father by one Spirit. Christ Our Cornerstone (Isaiah 28:14–22; 1 Corinthians 3:10–15; 1 Peter 2:1–8)

original.text: ὅτι διʼ αὐτοῦ ἔχομεν τὴν προσαγωγὴν οἱ ἀμφότεροι ἐν ἑνὶ πνεύματι πρὸς τὸν πατέρα.

verses.restored: So then you are no longer strangers and sojourners, but fellow citizens with the holy ones and members of the household of the Divine,

familiar.text: Now therefore ye are no more strangers and foreigners, but fellowcitizens with the saints, and of the household of God;

modern.text: Therefore you are no longer strangers and foreigners, but fellow citizens with the saints and members of God’s household,

original.text: ἄρα οὖν οὐκέτι ἐστὲ ξένοι καὶ πάροικοι, ἀλλὰ ⸀ἐστὲ συμπολῖται τῶν ἁγίων καὶ οἰκεῖοι τοῦ θεοῦ,

verses.restored: having been built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Messiah Jesus himself being cornerstone,

familiar.text: And are built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Jesus Christ himself being the chief corner stone;

modern.text: built on the foundation of the apostles and prophets, with Christ Jesus Himself as the cornerstone.

original.text: ἐποικοδομηθέντες ἐπὶ τῷ θεμελίῳ τῶν ἀποστόλων καὶ προφητῶν, ὄντος ἀκρογωνιαίου αὐτοῦ ⸂Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ⸃,

verses.restored: in whom the whole building, being joined together, grows into a holy temple in the Lord,

familiar.text: In whom all the building fitly framed together groweth unto an holy temple in the Lord:

modern.text: In Him the whole building is fitted together and grows into a holy temple in the Lord.

original.text: ἐν ᾧ ⸀πᾶσα οἰκοδομὴ συναρμολογουμένη αὔξει εἰς ναὸν ἅγιον ἐν κυρίῳ,

verses.restored: in whom you also are being built together into a dwelling place of the Divine in Spirit.

familiar.text: In whom ye also are builded together for an habitation of God through the Spirit.

modern.text: And in Him you too are being built together into a dwelling place for God in His Spirit.

original.text: ἐν ᾧ καὶ ὑμεῖς συνοικοδομεῖσθε εἰς κατοικητήριον τοῦ θεοῦ ἐν πνεύματι.

safety_note: Ephesians 2 must not be used as replacement theology. The nations are brought near to Israel's covenants and reconciled into one new humanity in Messiah; this is shared access and peace, not contempt for Israel or erasure of Jewish identity.
